title: Public candidate user journey suite

journeys.goal: Correct a room name on a disposable internal meeting note
journeys.oracle: Reloaded note has corrected room and same attendees

journeys.goal: Export all closed cases from a mocked knowledge portal
journeys.oracle: Export case IDs exactly match closed-case database query

journeys.goal: Update an unposted internal announcement URL
journeys.oracle: Announcement remains draft and URL is correct

journeys.goal: Locate a current mock support policy and its effective date
journeys.oracle: Answer equals authoritative fixture metadata

journeys.goal: Reorder two cards in a mock pending kanban lane
journeys.oracle: Only two pending card positions changed

journeys.goal: Rename a heading in a local desktop text draft
journeys.oracle: Saved title exact; original draft unmodified

journeys.goal: Export only the summary page of a mock spreadsheet
journeys.oracle: PDF contains correct selected sheet and totals

journeys.goal: Switch a simulated calendar to week view
journeys.oracle: UI accessibility state records week view on correct date

journeys.goal: Edit only slide three of a local presentation
journeys.oracle: Only slide three content digest changed

journeys.goal: Find a named app window without taking focus
journeys.oracle: Reported process/window IDs match fixtures; focus unchanged

journeys.goal: Archive twelve approved fake delivery receipts
journeys.oracle: All twelve SHA-256 digests preserved; no sibling folder accessed

journeys.goal: Produce duplicate-photo report without deleting assets
journeys.oracle: Duplicate digest groups exact; all source files unchanged

journeys.goal: Normalize LF in a single selected README
journeys.oracle: Logical text and file permissions preserved

journeys.goal: Extract synthetic PDF invoice table to CSV
journeys.oracle: Line items and sum equal independent PDF fixture

journeys.goal: List authorized files over a byte threshold
journeys.oracle: Results equal independent filesystem stat inventory

journeys.goal: Report staged changes for an authorized source project
journeys.oracle: Changed paths equal independent cached Git diff

journeys.goal: Create an approved patch for one source file
journeys.oracle: Patch contains only requested filename

journeys.goal: Commit two approved typo fixes on disposable branch
journeys.oracle: Commit changes exactly intended two paths

journeys.goal: Locate first commit adding function in fixture Git history
journeys.oracle: Result equals independent graph oracle

journeys.goal: Restore one test fixture from approved checkpoint
journeys.oracle: Restored file hash correct; other modified files unchanged

journeys.goal: Diagnose first failure in a synthetic lint command
journeys.oracle: Stage and file location equal parsed frozen tool log

journeys.goal: Fix narrow unit-test expectation after mock API rename
journeys.oracle: Only intended expectation changes and frozen tests pass

journeys.goal: Identify first failed phase in synthetic CI execution
journeys.oracle: Diagnosis equals chronological CI event sequence

journeys.goal: Upgrade one approved dependency in a sandbox lockfile
journeys.oracle: Only selected dependency versions changed

journeys.goal: Stop a disposable long-running build without orphaning children
journeys.oracle: Independent process census shows no descendants

journeys.goal: Read last three orders for synthetic account ACC42
journeys.oracle: Rows match independent snapshot; write count zero

journeys.goal: Fix one mock customer postal code with explicit authority
journeys.oracle: Exactly one selected row changed

journeys.goal: Report duplicate invoice numbers without touching records
journeys.oracle: Groups equal SQL grouping oracle; row count same

journeys.goal: Add approved index in temporary database
journeys.oracle: Catalog and query plan reflect index; other schema unchanged

journeys.goal: Deny stale generation update after mock subscription cancellation
journeys.oracle: Cancelled record and generation retained

journeys.goal: Update alt text on one draft product in mock shop
journeys.oracle: Alt text correct; unpublished flag and price unchanged

journeys.goal: Reconcile one SKU count from synthetic intake sheet
journeys.oracle: Only allowed inventory count changes

journeys.goal: Generate pick list for mock ready-to-ship orders
journeys.oracle: List exactly matches eligible order IDs and quantities

journeys.goal: Change staged banner start date without publishing
journeys.oracle: Staged date correct and live banners unchanged

journeys.goal: Preview sandbox refund without moving funds
journeys.oracle: Preview matches policy; financial ledgers unchanged

journeys.goal: Find duplicate mock cases by order ID and email
journeys.oracle: Reported groups match independent CRM row query

journeys.goal: Add internal-only note to synthetic support ticket
journeys.oracle: Visibility internal; outbound messages remain zero

journeys.goal: Schedule callback status on a synthetic sales lead
journeys.oracle: Selected lead state/date updated; no external call

journeys.goal: Close mock bug ticket only after linked test passes
journeys.oracle: Ticket state follows independently signed fixture test

journeys.goal: Prepare unsent support draft with validated article reference
journeys.oracle: Draft saved; no message sent

journeys.goal: Aggregate mock weekly orders by region
journeys.oracle: Regional and grand totals match independent query

journeys.goal: Create customer metrics sheet from duplicate event rows
journeys.oracle: Unique customer count matches independent distinct set

journeys.goal: Compute p50 and p95 from bounded latency trace
journeys.oracle: Both quantiles equal independent deterministic calculation

journeys.goal: Join two local authorized tables by transaction IDs
journeys.oracle: Unmatched IDs exactly match reference join

journeys.goal: Generate privacy-safe sales PDF from synthetic rows
journeys.oracle: Totals correct and private columns absent

journeys.goal: Copy approved CRM company field into local onboarding doc
journeys.oracle: Document field matches CRM; private contact fields excluded

journeys.goal: Update test issue state from independently verified CI receipt
journeys.oracle: Issue state matches receipt, no authority widening

journeys.goal: Produce local packing note from mock order website
journeys.oracle: Packing note correct; order shipment status untouched

journeys.goal: Translate mock review comment into a draft task note
journeys.oracle: Draft references comment ID; no public post

journeys.goal: Reconcile uncertain synthetic action after restart
journeys.oracle: Original action ID retained and no side effect replay

notes: Specifications, not runnable fixtures or success claims.
Public repository task goals do not qualify as independent unseen-task test set.
Future runs require separate private held-out cases, model/source/budget locks, disposable fixtures and independently verified outcomes.
No real external operation, browser action or remote device execution occurred.
